problems.failure: RuntimeError: RAM guard below 2.5 GiB for 180 s (available 2.479 GiB)
problems.cause: The P24 2.5 GiB emergency free-RAM threshold was too close to normal GitHub-hosted runner steady-state availability. The simulator ran for about 88 minutes without an allocation/OOM error before a periodic 50-interval guard check intentionally aborted it.
problems.fix: lower only the hosted-CI emergency free-RAM guard to 1.5 GiB; keep disk guard 5 GiB, one experiment process, three CPU threads, workload, seed, scheduler, response-law numerics, timeline and label rule unchanged
problems.scientific_effect: no finalized stream or model result was produced; this is an execution-environment safety threshold correction only. response_law_v1 and all scientific parameters remain unchanged
problems.exact_interval_note: collector checks RAM every 50 intervals but the failed run did not emit the current t, so the exact simulated interval count is not reconstructed from wall time
